info.name: Strapi Users and Permissions Authentication API
info.description:
The Strapi Users and Permissions API provides a full authentication process based on JSON Web Tokens (JWT) to protect API endpoints, along with an access-control list (ACL) strategy for managing permissions between groups of users.

Contact Support:
 Name: Strapi Support
